Quick summary: Comparing the 2027 Mazda CX-5 (gasoline 2.5 S) vs the 2027 Mazda CX-90 Plug‑in Hybrid (PHEV Preferred).

Key differences (concise): • Powertrain: CX-5 = 2.5L gasoline 4‑cyl (187 hp / 186 lb‑ft). CX‑90 PHEV = plug‑in hybrid (combined 323 hp / 369 lb‑ft) + 17.8 kWh battery. • Electric range: CX‑90 PHEV up to 27 miles EV. CX‑5 has no electric-only range. • Price (base MSRP): CX‑5 $29,990 + destination; CX‑90 PHEV $50,695 + destination (MSRPs exclude destination, taxes, title, options, dealer fees). • Seating/cargo: CX‑5 = 5 passengers; cargo rear seats up 33.7 cu ft, down 66.5 cu ft. CX‑90 PHEV = 7 passengers (3 rows). • Efficiency/performance: CX‑5 AWD EPA 24/30 (city/hwy). CX‑90 PHEV provides PHEV performance and electric-first commuting (spec sheet values above).

Notes & caveats: Data from Mazda U.S. 2027 release and product pages (checked 2026-11-13). Trims and published specs apply to the announced U.S. configurations; exact exterior/interior color availability, seating option effects and final configurator combinations may vary. MSRPs exclude destination, taxes, title, options and dealer fees. Want a deeper side‑by‑side table (range, towing, curb weight, detailed cargo dimensions) or a comparison of a different CX‑5 trim?
